question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose agents.defaults.memorySearch.queryInstructionTemplate and applyQueryInstructionTemplate as public config and Plugin SDK contracts, or keep model-specific query formatting within provider-owned implementation surfaces?
rationale: The behavior is useful and opt-in, but adding user configuration and public plugin API is a durable product and compatibility choice that code review cannot safely decide from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Approve the narrow opt-in contract
options.body: Keep the default false setting and shared helper, but restore the reported guidance, document the supported model semantics, rebase, and require exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Keep formatting provider-owned
options.body: Remove the generic public helper/config contract and place model-specific formatting behind an owner-approved provider-level seam.

options.title: Pause the new surface
options.body: Close or defer the PR if the retrieval benefit does not justify another memory-search config and Plugin SDK commitment.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Keep the default false setting and shared helper, but restore the reported guidance, document the supported model semantics, rebase, and require exact-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history across the OpenAI embedding, memory embedding, and generic provider boundaries affected by the contract decision.
